community.title: Community Guidelines - CircleSfera
community.header_subtitle: The rules of engagement for the CircleSfera universe.

sections.s1_content: CircleSfera is a premium, tier-based social network designed for authentic connections, high-quality visual storytelling, and professional creator monetization. We prioritize quality over noise. All members are expected to contribute to an environment of respect, creativity, and value.
sections.s2_content: Harassment, hate speech, bullying, or discrimination of any kind is strictly prohibited. We have a zero-tolerance policy for abuse. Engage in constructive discussions and treat fellow members of the CircleSfera universe with dignity.
sections.s3_content: Share content that you own or have the right to distribute. Do not post illegal, explicit, or copyright-infringing material. As a platform that empowers creators, we fiercely protect intellectual property rights.
sections.s4_content: Artificial engagement, botting, spamming, and deceptive practices degrade the premium experience. Do not use automated tools to inflate metrics. Authentic engagement is the core metric of influence on CircleSfera.
sections.s5_content: Creators utilizing our monetization tools (subscriptions, tips, highlights) must deliver promised value to their subscribers. Fraudulent subscription offerings or misleading promotional campaigns will result in immediate account termination.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy - CircleSfera
privacy.header_subtitle: How we protect your data in the CircleSfera universe.

sections.s1_content: At CircleSfera, we value your privacy above all. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your data as a provider of a refined social networking experience and creator tools. We are committed to transparency and security in every interaction.
sections.s2_content: To provide our service, we collect Account Information (email, credentials), Profile Data (uploaded media, bios), and Billing Information. Billing details are processed securely by Stripe; CircleSfera never stores full card numbers on its servers.
sections.s3_content: Your data is used exclusively to maintain your social experience and process subscriptions. Under our SaaS model, we do not facilitate peer-to-peer money transfers or third-party marketplace settlements, ensuring your data stays within our secure ecosystem.
sections.s4_content: CircleSfera employs industry-standard encryption and security protocols to safeguard your universe. All financial transactions are handled by Stripe, a PCI-compliant payment provider, ensuring the highest level of trust.
sections.s5_content: For any privacy concerns or data requests, our specialized legal team is ready to assist. Contact us directly at legal@circlesfera.com for comprehensive support regarding your digital rights.

terms.title: Terms of Service - CircleSfera
terms.header_subtitle: The agreement between you and CircleSfera.

sections.s1_content: CircleSfera is a social network designed for authentic and creative expression. By using our service, you agree to engage respectfully with the community. Any attempt to use the platform for unauthorized financial transactions or peer-to-peer money transmission is strictly prohibited.
sections.s2_content: Subscription tiers (Verified, Elite Creator, Business) provide access to specialized social features, growth tools, and profile enhancements. All payments are processed exclusively by CircleSfera as the provider of the service. We do not support third-party payouts, marketplace settlements, or creator-to-user direct monetization.
sections.s3_content: You retain ownership of the content you share in your universe. However, you grant CircleSfera a worldwide, non-exclusive license to host and display this content as part of the service.
sections.s4_content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms or engage in activities that compromise platform security or compliance.
sections.s5_content: CircleSfera is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We are not liable for indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of the platform.

quotes.privacy: Your privacy is the cornerstone of our social ecosystem. We deploy military-grade security architecture to protect every bit.
quotes.terms: These terms are designed to ensure a fair, transparent, and mutually beneficial relationship between you and CircleSfera.
quotes.community: Our community is built on mutual respect and creative freedom. These guidelines help maintain a positive environment for everyone.

feed.seo_desc: How Home works on CircleSfera: For You, Following, stories, and highlights with explicit control.
feed.title: Feed and Stories
feed.lead: Home is where CircleSfera starts after signup — dense posts, ephemeral stories, and lasting highlights, with preferences you can change.

p1.title: For You and Following
p1.body: Two reading modes on the same Home. Following prioritizes people you chose. For You ranks discovery from signals you can change.

p2.title: Stories and highlights
p2.body: Stories are short-lived by design. Highlights keep selected moments on your profile so you decide what stays in view.

p3.title: Control stays with you
p3.body: Mute, hide, feed preferences, and appeals live in Settings. You decide what stays in your feed.

feed.closing: Create an account to open Home with the same surfaces described here.

frames.seo_desc: Short vertical video inside CircleSfera — same account, same relationships, not a separate app.
frames.title: Frames
frames.lead: Frames is CircleSfera’s short-video surface: vertical viewing with the same identity, follows, and moderation rules as the rest of the product.

p1.title: One account, one graph
p1.body: You do not rebuild followers for video. Frames sits beside Feed and Stories under the same profile and relationships.

p2.title: Built for density
p2.body: The surface is built for short vertical clips — a focused layout, fast next/previous, and the same look as Home.

p3.title: Same trust rules
p3.body: Reports, appeals, and visibility limits apply here too. Creator monetization paths stay explicit when they intersect Frames.

frames.closing: Sign up to open Frames in the app. Guests can keep reading other surfaces from Explore.

direct.seo_desc: Private messaging on CircleSfera with the people you choose — the same look as the rest of the product.
direct.title: Direct
direct.lead: Direct is private messaging inside CircleSfera: conversations stay with the people you choose, under the same account and safety model.

p1.title: People you choose
p1.body: Threads are tied to your relationships and privacy choices — not a public comment stream dressed as chat.

p2.title: Same product, not an add-on
p2.body: Inbox and threads use the same look and navigation as the rest of CircleSfera, including on mobile.

p3.title: Safety is explicit
p3.body: Blocks, reports, and account limits apply to messaging too. Enforcement is communicated — not hidden as a silent mute of your reach.

direct.closing: Create an account to open Direct. Until then, Explore explains every surface that ships today.

live.seo_desc: Go live on CircleSfera: real-time chat, audience tools, and creator gifts in one product.
live.title: Live
live.lead: Live lets creators broadcast and audiences join in real time — chat, presence, and support tools in the same CircleSfera identity.

p1.title: Broadcast and watch
p1.body: Creators go live from the product; viewers join a dedicated session with real-time updates — not a third-party embed glued on.

p2.title: Chat in the moment
p2.body: Live chat sits with the stream so reactions stay in context. Moderation and reporting remain available during the session.

p3.title: Support creators openly
p3.body: Gifts and related monetization paths are product features with visible pricing rules — not opaque boosts.

live.closing: Sign up to host or join Live. Pricing explains platform plans when you need paid capabilities.

creator.seo_desc: Subscriptions, unlocks, and Stripe-backed monetization with an explicit 20% platform fee.
creator.title: Creator tools
creator.lead: Creator Studio and monetization features help you earn on CircleSfera with prices and fees you can see before you pay or charge.

p1.title: Subscriptions and unlocks
p1.body: Offer paid access and unlocks through flows backed by Stripe. Entitlements are server-side — the client never invents prices.

p2.title: Transparent platform fee
p2.body: CircleSfera’s platform fee is explicit (20%). Pricing pages show plan costs before checkout; no silent add-ons in copy.

p3.title: Trust and verification
p3.body: Some monetization paths require identity verification. Limits and requirements are stated up front — not discovered after a failed charge.

creator.closing: Read Pricing for plan details, then create an account to open Creator Studio when you are eligible.

seo.title: CircleSfera — Your feed. You decide.
seo.description: CircleSfera is a social network for posts, stories, Frames, Direct, and Live. You choose what you see and who can reach you.

hero.subtitle: Posts, stories, Frames, Direct, and Live. You choose what you see and who can reach you.

features.title: One account. Every format.
features.subtitle: Posts, stories, short video, messages, live, and creator tools. Same look, same relationships.

feed.title: Feed and Stories
feed.desc: For You and Following with dense posts. Ephemeral stories and lasting highlights on your profile — you decide what stays in view.

frames.title: Frames
frames.desc: Short video on a dedicated vertical surface inside CircleSfera — the same account, the same relationships, not a separate app.

direct.title: Direct
direct.desc: Private messaging with the same look as the rest of the product. Conversations stay with the people you choose.

live.title: Live
live.desc: Go live, chat in real time, and support creators with gifts. Broadcast and audience tools live in the same product surface.

creator.title: Creator tools
creator.desc: Subscriptions, unlocks, and Stripe-backed monetization. Platform fee is explicit (20%). Pricing is visible before you pay.

principles.title: Control you can use.
principles.subtitle: Five rules for what you see, who can reach you, and how your data is used.

control.title: User control first
control.desc: You decide what you consume, who can interact, and what you get recommended. Automation helps — it does not override your choices.

transparency.title: Why you see this
transparency.desc: What shows up in For You and Explore should make sense: this post, this profile, and what you did that changed it.

no_suppression.title: Visibility you control
no_suppression.desc: Mute, hide, and feed preferences change what you see. Following is the people you chose. For You is a mix you can adjust in Settings.

moderation.title: Strict, explicit moderation
moderation.desc: Community rules are public. You can report content, and you can appeal a decision from Settings.

data.title: Responsible data handling
data.desc: We keep what the product needs, and we should be able to say why. Export and deletion are in Settings.

faq.title: Straight answers
faq.subtitle: What CircleSfera is today — plans, the feed, and how to use it on your phone.

free.a: Yes. The main social features are free. Optional plans (Premium, Elite Creator, Business) and creator monetization go through Stripe — prices are on Pricing before you pay.

verify.a: Identity verification is in Settings, via Stripe Identity, when you need it for monetization or trust. Plan badges (Verified / Elite / Business) come from an active subscription.

control.q: Do I control what I see?
control.a: Yes. Feed preferences, mute, hide, and appeals are in Settings. You choose what you see and who can interact with you.

mobile.a: CircleSfera works in the browser on your phone and on desktop. You can add it to your home screen. There is no App Store or Google Play app yet.

plans.a: Premium, Elite Creator, and Business are optional subscriptions billed through Stripe. What they include and what they cost is on Pricing, before you pay.

support.a: Yes. Log in, write from Support, and a person replies to the email on your account. It is not a help center with nobody behind it.
